rows.notes: Listed in the calculation as "CAT 3516", 3,000 kW. Emissions are before the SCR and oxidation catalyst; the ppm basis is not stated and is taken as ppmvd @15% O2. Heat consumption and heat rate are gross, and taken as LHV because the efficiencies match LHV ratings (the application's own Method 19 calculation treats them as HHV). Exhaust temperature is at the turbine exit; flows in the table include tempering air and are not stored. The M501JAC cases give NOx 2 ppm, CO 2 ppm, no tempering air and 760-825 F exhaust, unlike the other OEMs; they look like values after an SCR / heat recovery, so emissions_point is left as stated in the table but treat them with care.
